summary: Reviewed src/setup/checkbox-menu.ts and related files (raw-mode.ts, colors.ts, types.ts). All 10 OWASP Top 10 categories assessed. 0 Critical, 0 High. 1 Medium (signal re-entrancy in sigintHandler — no self-removal before process.kill re-raise). 1 Low (ANSI pass-through from label/desc into terminal — developer-controlled data, low risk). Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: Medium — A04 (Insecure Design) — Signal re-entrancy in sigintHandler. File: src/setup/checkbox-menu.ts, sigintHandler closure (approx. lines 84–87). sigintHandler does not call process.off('SIGINT', sigintHandler) before invoking process.kill(process.pid, 'SIGINT'). Since the handler remains registered at the time of the kill, the re-raised SIGINT will invoke sigintHandler again on the next event-loop tick, creating a re-entrancy loop: restoreTerminal() is called repeatedly (idempotent, no direct harm) and the kill is issued again each iteration. In practice Node.js will eventually terminate the process, but the pattern is unsafe — it could interfere with upstream SIGINT handlers or behave unpredictably in environments with multiple handlers. Remediation: add process.off('SIGINT', sigintHandler) as the FIRST statement inside sigintHandler, before calling restoreTerminal() and process.kill(). This mirrors the pattern already used in cleanup() for the clean-exit path.

Low — A03 (Injection) — ANSI escape sequence pass-through in buildLines(). File: src/setup/checkbox-menu.ts, lines ~24 and ~27 (label and desc interpolation). components[i].label and components[i].desc are interpolated into ANSI-wrapped terminal output (via C.dim / C.bold) without stripping embedded escape sequences. Any ANSI control sequence embedded in those strings would be written verbatim to stdout and executed by the terminal emulator (e.g., cursor hide \x1b[?25l, screen clear \x1b[2J). For the library's current usage (statically-defined developer-controlled component metadata), this is negligible. No remediation required for current use. Note for future callers: if SetupComponent label/desc values ever originate from external sources (config files, network, user input), sanitize escape sequences before passing to runCheckboxMenu().
